content.title: Tractor Supply Stock Has Been Slumping. Buy the Dip, Citi Says.
content.summary: Tractor Supply had a rough September and the start to October hasn’t been much smoother.  The firm upgraded  Tractor Supply  to Buy from Hold and nudged its target price to $62 from $60, predicting a return to normalized growth due in part to a series of new sales initiatives.  Shares were rising 1.5% to $54.70 in premarket trading Thursday.
